misclassified_entities.reason: Internal component - smart contract code executing within the EVM, not external to the system
Internal system state - a transaction that has passed validation is an internal data flow, not an external entity
Internal component - the EVM execution context is part of the system under audit, not external

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External transaction triggering contract execution. Transaction may contain malicious calldata or be crafted to trigger unexpected code paths including INVALID opcodes. All execution results must be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
trusted_external_entities.rationale: User or application submitting transactions. May submit transactions with invalid nonces, excessive values, or malicious intent. All transaction fields including nonce must be validated against protocol limits.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Contract execution must handle all possible bytecode paths including INVALID opcodes. Gas limits must be enforced to prevent resource exhaustion.
Transaction nonce must be validated against 2^64-1 limit. Signature must be verified. All transaction fields must be within protocol bounds.
